| Module         | Contains                                                      |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `orm.py`       | Factory fixtures that create/persist SQLAlchemy models        |
| `auth.py`      | JWTs, `AuthenticatedUser`, login responses, mock auth service |
| `users.py`     | User model fixtures (active, inactive, admin, regular user)   |
| `responses.py` | Common API response objects                                   |
| `database.py`  | Database/session fixtures                                     |
